messages:
Lena (CS): Heads-up — BrightPath is hitting intermittent 500s from our embeddings endpoint on their Dedicated cluster (us-west-2). They sent repro steps and logs below, asked us to triage and prioritize.

Jasper (BrightPath): repro steps — running batch embed with ~80 documents. Endpoint: POST https://dedicated-us-west2.api.redwood/v1/embeddings model=embed-rw-4x

```
# curl reproducer (trimmed)
curl -X POST \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' \ 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ 
  -d '{"model":"embed-rw-4x","input":["doc1","doc2", ..., "doc80"]}' \ 
  https://dedicated-us-west2.api.redwood/v1/embeddings
```

Jasper (BrightPath): response: 500 Internal Server Error, body: `{ "error": "internal server error", "id": "req_8f3a" }`. Happens ~30% of requests when batch size >= 64. Lowering to 32 stops it. No consistent trace id beyond that.

Lena (CS): Additional context from BrightPath: search index build runs nightly, this affects their product ingestion job (customers see stale search). They can temporarily reduce batch size but that adds 3x processing time. Customer asks for ETA and fix plan. Impact: revenue-sensitive.

Alex (eng-intake): Thanks — capturing. Can you paste the full error logs/trace IDs if they have them? Also need to know whether this is only on Dedicated us-west-2 and whether they are using quantized model or any special config. I will create a ticket: label with customer-intake + dedicated + severity.

Jasper (BrightPath): they use our Dedicated pool with model flagged `q4_k_m` quantized variant. No custom routing. We'll attach app logs shortly.

Ryan (eng-oncall): quick thought: if it correlates to batch size and quantization, might be hitting a memory edge in the batching path or an OOM in the pinned host memory. Can we get kernel-level logs and the runtime error? For immediate mitigation: advise customer to 1) set max_batch_size=32 in client OR 2) enable client-side retry with exponential backoff (3 attempts) and small jitter.

Marco (eng-ml): Agree with Ryan. Quantized kernels can have different memory footprints under batching. Hypothesis: when batch > 64, CPU pinned buffers spike and we hit allocation failure -> generic 500. Short-term mitigation: clamp batch sizes server-side for dedicated customers and return 400 + descriptive message so customer knows to reduce batch. Long-term: add guard in runtime to split large batches into internal micro-batches and track memory usage.

Maria (product): We need to prioritize this. Acceptance criteria proposal:
- Repro in staging with Dedicated config + q4_k_m model.
- Add server-side guard to reject >32 with helpful error OR automatic server-side split without correctness change.
- Add metric/alert (rate of 500s for embeddings per cluster).
- Communication: notify BrightPath and provide ETA and workaround.

Alex (eng-intake): I'll create the backlog ticket with `severity:high`, assign to eng-ml, and request triage meeting tomorrow 11:00am PT. Will include the reproducer, sample logs, and customer impact note.

Lena (CS): I'll attach the customer's logs and the nightly job schedule, plus go/no-go signal from BrightPath for temporary throttling.

Jasper (BrightPath): Appreciate it — patch or guardrails are fine. We prefer automatic server-side split if possible so we don't have to change client.

Ryan (eng-oncall): If customer is blocked overnight and this is high-impact, I'll prepare an emergency patch to return a 400 with a clear message so they can roll faster.

Marco (eng-ml): For engineering intake: steps to reproduce we want in the ticket:
1) Launch Dedicated staging node with same runtime config as us-west-2.
2) Run embed API with `model=embed-rw-4x (q4_k_m)` and batch sizes 16/32/64/80.
3) Capture runtime logs (`/var/log/redwood/runtime.log`) and `dmesg` for OOM.
4) Measure memory usage during steady-state batching.

Maria (product): Prioritization note: BrightPath is on a paid Dedicated plan and uses embeddings for core search ingestion. Recommend fast-follow on backlog (P1) with engineering time boxed to 3 sprints if split requires larger change.

Lena (CS): Confirmed — opening ticket now and will post the issue link here when done.

Alex (eng-intake): Issue created: https://redwood.internal/issue/RED-4321 (labels: customer-intake, dedicated, severity-high). Assigned to Marco. Triage meeting invite sent. :calendar: :eyes:

Lena (CS): Thanks everyone. I'll keep BrightPath updated and paste any additional logs here. :shipit:

Ryan (eng-oncall): Ping me if they still see >5% failure rate overnight and I'll priority patch.
